quotes.text: Jan 21, 2024: a deepfake of Joe Biden told New Hampshire Democrats not to vote. Cost: ~$1 to generate.
NewsGuard's UAINS tracker logged 1,254 AI-generated 'news' websites as of mid-2024 — up from 49 the year before.
March 2023: the Pope in a Balenciaga puffer was the first viral synthetic image to fool the general internet.
Oct 27, 2022: Elon Musk fires Twitter's CEO, CFO, and head of legal in the first 24 hours.
X's own AI 'Grok' now appends real-time corrections to viral posts — sometimes contradicting the user who paid for verification.
A 2023 Stanford study found participants could not reliably distinguish LLM-generated political content from human-written.
Apr 18, 2023: Fox News pays Dominion Voting Systems $787.5M to settle a defamation suit. Largest media settlement in U.S. history.
Modern voice-clone models need ~11 seconds of clean source audio to produce convincing speech in the target's voice.
The Drudge Report still posts. Most of its 2024 traffic came from search engines, not direct visits.
